why.violenceCartoonOrFantasy: None. The creature shivers, sleeps and hides from rain; nothing is hurt.
why.userGeneratedContent: No. The only typed text is a name for your own creature and questions to its AI, which only the typing player sees. Nothing typed is shared with other players.
why.messagingAndChat: No chat between players. Crossing sends only the creature's seed, name, colour and traits.
why.unrestrictedWebAccess: No in-app browser. The four AI-key links in Settings open the providers' key pages in Safari.
why.advertising: No ads in the app. The web about page's sponsor slot is web-only (src/landing/ads.ts returns early on native).
